home.headline:
Five rooms, one bay,
and nothing plugged into the grid
home.sub: Built from local timber above Ekas Bay. Run on sunlight. Four minutes from the sand and a long way from everywhere else.

stay.title: The rooms
stay.intro: Three rooms on the lower level, a two-bedroom villa, and an apartment upstairs with the view. Take one, or take the lot.
stay.buyoutNote: Every room, both pools, the run of the place.

surf.title: The surf
surf.intro: Inside Ekas breaks in front of the villa. Outside is a boat ride away, and empties out the moment the day-trippers go home.

sustainability.title: Off the grid
sustainability.intro: Not a solar panel on the roof and a sign about towels. The whole property runs on sunlight, the water goes back into the gardens, and the timber came from up the road.

gettingHere.title: Getting here
gettingHere.intro: It takes a bit of doing. That is the point — the road is the reason the bay is still quiet.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: Send a message and we will come back to you within a day. Tell us your dates and how many of you there are.
